function.description: Use only for an explicit count, how-many, or total request over Primary, Secondary, or Anchor Managed AP Location (`managedLocation`) WLC-to-site relationship categories associated with one wireless controller. Resolve a controller hostname, management IP, or serial number to its canonical networkDeviceId and then call this API; controller resolution alone is not the result. Always return the requested category counts and an explicit combined total. For primary-and-secondary queries return Primary count, Secondary count, and Total (Primary + Secondary); include Anchor only when explicitly requested or when all managed-location categories are requested.
function.name: api_getManagedAPLocationsCountForSpecificWirelessController

networkDeviceId.description: Required canonical wireless-controller UUID only. Do not pass the controller hostname, FQDN, management IP, or serial number here. For those identifiers, first call get_device_details for the Wireless Controller, take its canonical device ID/UUID, and continue to this Managed AP Location API with that UUID as networkDeviceId; controller resolution is not the final answer.

anchorManagedApLocationsCount.description: The count of the Anchor managed ap  locations.

primaryManagedApLocationsCount.description: The count of the Primary managed ap locations.

secondaryManagedApLocationsCount.description: The count of the Secondary managed ap locations.
